title: Purpose and Procedural Context
guidance: The report purpose, author, procedural setting, and material events that explain why it was prepared.

title: Material Facts and Chronology
guidance: Material events and their dates. Distinguish the date of an event from the date it was reported.

title: Evidence and Sources
guidance: Material observations, interviews, documents, and other evidence, with source attribution and reliability qualifications.

title: Disputes and Competing Accounts
guidance: Material disagreements and competing accounts, with distinct attribution and unresolved uncertainty.

title: Findings and Conclusions Attributed to Their Author
guidance: Attribute assessments and conclusions to the report author or identified decision maker; do not turn an opinion into a court finding.

title: Recommendations/Proposed Relief
guidance: Material recommendations and requested relief, explicitly attributed as proposed rather than ordered.

title: Material Developments and Unresolved Issues
guidance: Meaningful developments, qualifications, and unresolved questions. Do not repeat content already placed in a better category.
